root_cause.text: The `snd_card`'s `private_free` destructor (which releases the USB device reference acquired via `usb_get_dev()`) is assigned too late in the initialization sequence, causing probe failures prior to this assignment to skip the cleanup and leak the reference.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that `card->private_free = card_free;` is moved from `init_card()` to `create_card()`, immediately after `usb_get_dev(usb_dev)` is called, ensuring that any early failure paths that trigger `snd_card_free()` will execute `card_free()` and release the reference.
